title: Subsequence evaluation respects restriction composition
statement:
For subsequences r,s and any index c, evaluation at c of the derived restriction compositor, followed by composite-selected evaluation, equals selected evaluation along s after restriction by r followed by evaluation along r at s(c), on every derived strict system.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe u v w
variable {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})]
  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{w}] [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{w}]
  (B : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Sheaf J CommRingCat.{w})
theorem systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation_composition (r s : ℕ ↪o ℕ) (c : ℕ)
    (M : DerivedCategory (StrictRingSystem B)) :
    (derivedSystemEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B (s.trans r)) c).map
        ((systemDerivedSubsequenceComposition B r s).hom.app M) ≫
      (systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation B (s.trans r) c).hom.app M =
    (systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation (selectedSystemRings B r) s c).hom.app
        ((derivedSystemSubsequence B r).obj M) ≫
      (systemDerivedSubsequenceEvaluation B r (s c)).hom.app M
```
